Name: Puffs and Pastries
Author: vyranity
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/16843/16843-1685267861-1540772109.png[/img]
[size=3]This mod adds [b]43 new pastry related items[/b] that can all be baked using the kitchen.
In addition to this some pastries require butter which can be made using the butter churn (unless you use the PFM free version).

About 11 items can only be baked when certain mods are installed. This is mostly because some of the items require chocolate which is not something that's in the vanilla game. 
These mods include PPJA more trees, fruits and veggies and more recipes. You can still play the mod without these mods however :D[/size]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/16843/16843-1685267867-2058758191.png[/img]

[size=3]
This is generally a finished mod, so it won't receive any new content apart from translations and possible bug fixes.
I might however make a puffs and pastries 2 (I will probably go for a more creative name) that would be very similar to this mod and will probably add about 40 new items as well in the future! :D
So if you have any ideas on desserts or pastries that aren't in this mod, feel free to let me know :D

Also if you have some fun ideas on future mods, I would love to hear them. I have kind of gone through all of the major baking ideas I had, so it can be something completely different too.[/size]
